limitations: Veto plus closest-range scoring remains experimental: matching background can hide real foreground blockers.
Real raw cases have no independent absolute trajectory truth; backend pose agreement is not an accuracy pass.
Frontend diagnostic binary and installed binary diverge numerically over the long trajectory; do not use those runs for a controlled accuracy improvement claim.
Finite-difference acceleration is a diagnostic substitute, not a qualified sensor implementation.
All frontend variants still fail the gross mapping quality gate; simulator repair is delegated to its project owner.
Resolution runs are unpaced prefix ablations, not controlled CPU qualification.

registration_threads.interpretation: Changing registration workers preserves this prefix decision sequence; four workers reduce elapsed lock time but do not reduce total CPU work. Keep the Product default of four.
limitations: One unpaced difficult 100-frame prefix per setting, not a paced half-core qualification.
The simulator owner session was also active; timings are exploratory, not an isolated performance claim.
The registration worker count is not a process-wide CPU cap.
